en-US.name: Meow: AI Agent Notifications
en-US.subtitle: Your agents, in your pocket
en-US.promotional_text: Let your agents work. Meow brings new results, errors, and requests for your attention to your iPhone, so you can step away and return when it matters.
en-US.description:
Let your agents work. Meow brings their updates to your iPhone.

Get notified when an AI agent finishes a turn, encounters an error, or needs your attention. Read the context on your phone, then continue in the original tool on your computer.

CONNECT YOUR WORKFLOW
Connect Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor with the Meow command-line tool. Scripts, build jobs, and other services can send notifications through the CLI or HTTP API too. The CLI is available for macOS and Linux.

AN INBOX THAT STAYS ORGANIZED
Browse messages by session, project, or agent. Search downloaded history on your device, including while offline. Mark messages or groups read, or delete the items you no longer need.

READ THE WHOLE RESULT
Open a notification to read the full message, with Markdown, code blocks, and tables. Session and project context help you recognize which task needs you.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose the Meow sound or the default system notification sound. Important messages can use Time Sensitive notifications when allowed by your iOS notification and Focus settings.

CHOOSE YOUR SERVER
Start with the suggested official server, or connect to a Meow server you host yourself. No personal Meow account is required. Messages sent to a server are cached there; downloaded history is stored on your iPhone. See the privacy policy for data handling and retention.

Meow delivers notifications. Replies and decisions stay in the original tool on your computer. Notification delivery requires a working network connection and the relevant system permissions.

zh-Hans.promotional_text: Agent 在忙，你忙你的。任务有新结果、遇到错误或需要你关注时，让 Meow 把消息送到 iPhone。手机查看，回到电脑继续。
zh-Hans.keywords: 开发者,推送,终端,自动化,编程,工作流,提醒,自托管,命令行,脚本,构建,任务
zh-Hans.description:
有消息，喵你一下。

Meow 把 AI 智能体的工作进展送到你的 iPhone。任务有新结果、遇到错误或需要你关注时，及时收到提醒。手机查看上下文，回到电脑继续，不必一直盯着终端。

连接你的工作流
通过 Meow 命令行工具接入 Claude Code、Codex 或 Cursor。脚本、构建任务和其他服务也可以通过 CLI 或 HTTP API 发送通知。电脑端支持 macOS 和 Linux。

让消息井井有条
按消息、会话、项目或 Agent 浏览收件箱。在手机本地搜索已下载的历史，离线也能查找。消息和分组支持标为已读，以及删除不再需要的内容。

读到完整结果
点开通知查看全文，支持 Markdown、代码块和表格。会话名、项目名和 Agent 信息，让你知道是哪项工作需要关注。

选择喜欢的提醒方式
使用猫叫声或系统默认提示音。重要消息可使用时效性通知，具体提醒方式由你的 iOS 通知和专注模式设置控制。

选择信任的服务器
可直接使用建议的官方服务器，也可以连接自托管的 Meow 服务器。无需创建个人 Meow 账号。发送的消息会在所选服务器上缓存，下载后的历史保存在 iPhone；数据处理与保存期限详见隐私说明。

Meow 负责通知；回复与决定仍在电脑上的原工具中完成。通知投递需要可用的网络连接和相应系统权限。

review.notes:
Meow is a notification companion for AI agents and developer workflows. It receives results, errors, and attention reminders; replies and decisions take place in the original tool on the user's computer. No Meow account or third-party AI account is required to review the iPhone app.

REVIEW ON AN IPHONE WITHOUT A COMPUTER
1. Launch the app. Keep the suggested server https://api.meow.blue and tap Get started. This creates an anonymous device registration.
2. Allow notifications when prompted (you can still inspect the inbox if notifications are disabled).
3. On Connect your computer, a Device Key and CLI instructions are shown. You do not need to install the CLI to review the app. Tap Next to reach Test connection.
4. Tap Send a test from this iPhone. This tests the server and push delivery without installing an agent. If the setup screen keeps waiting for a computer-originated test, tap Skip for now to enter the inbox.
5. Settings also contains Send a test notification. Use it to create a test message, view the inbox and open the full message. To inspect an alert outside the app, send the test and return to the Home Screen.
6. Inspect the view switcher, local search, notification details, read/delete swipe actions, sound preferences, and server settings. Grouped views become useful once several notifications share a session/project/source.

OPTIONAL COMPUTER INTEGRATION
The public installation instructions at https://meow.blue/ explain how to install the macOS/Linux CLI and connect an agent. Use the Device Key generated by the reviewing iPhone in your own terminal. No supplied demo credentials are needed. Never send Device Keys to us or include them in feedback.

The suggested official HTTPS server is running. Self-hosting is optional and no Apple Developer account is needed to use the official service. Time Sensitive alerts depend on iOS notification/Focus permissions. This app does not use Critical Alerts or provide phone-side approvals.

Privacy policy: https://meow.blue/privacy/
Public support contact: admin@meow.blue

Operational request logs contain network and diagnostic metadata; official policy says 30 days.
Downloaded history, local searches, read state and sound settings stay on device, except explicit server API operations.
No advertising or third-party behavioral analytics SDK.
